6 Best Mechanical Keyboards in Singapore (2026): From $79, Plus the Black Friday Deals | MissLobang Miss Lobang Food Deals Lifestyle News Kids 中文 Lifestyle 6 Best Mechanical Keyboards in Singapore (2026): From $79, Plus the Black Friday Deals
 Six mechanical keyboard brands worth buying in Singapore, from a $79 Logitech tenkeyless to a $389 ROG Azoth, with every price read on 21 November 2026 from the brand's Singapore store or the local retailer selling it, plus the Black Friday markdowns that end on 26 and 30 November.
 Marcus Wong 21 November 2026 8 min read Black Friday has pushed a proper mechanical keyboard down to $79 in Singapore this week. 
 > Quick view: cheapest is the Logitech G413 TKL SE at $79 (to 26 Nov); the best all-rounder is the Keychron K8 Max at $181 ; most good boards cost $150 to $250 . Harvey Norman's markdowns end 26 November. 
 1 Keychron: Best All-Rounder for Mac and Windows, K8 Max at $181
 The pick for most people who type all day and game a little. PRICE: on keychronsg.com on 21 November 2026 the K8 Max (wireless tenkeyless, RGB, aluminium frame, hot-swappable) is $181 , the K2 HE (75%, magnetic switches, wireless) is $199 for the standard version ($215 special edition), the K8 Ultra 8K is $180 and the gasket-mounted Q1 Max is $315 fully assembled or $280 barebone. Cheaper K8 Max variants ($79 to $89) were sold out that day. WHY KEYCHRON: every board ships with Mac and Windows keycaps and a switch on the side, connects over Bluetooth, 2.4GHz or cable, and is remappable in the free Keychron Launcher. RETAIL: Challenger also stocks it (K8 Max $175, K2 Max $179 on online.challenger.sg). DELIVERY: the Singapore store says orders ship within 2 business days. NO SALE: we found no dated Black Friday promotion on keychronsg.com. 
 Visit website 2 Logitech G: Cheapest Good Mechanical Keyboard, G413 TKL SE at $79 to 26 November
 The cheapest mechanical keyboard we would actually recommend. PRICE (Harvey Norman, 21 November 2026): the G413 TKL SE (tenkeyless, tactile switches, white backlight) is $79, down from $94 , and the full-size G512 is $99 (was $139) . Going wireless, the low-profile G515 Lightspeed TKL is $139 (was $189) and the esports PRO X TKL Lightspeed is $189 (was $279) . THE DEAL: these prices are part of Harvey Norman's Black Friday Comes Early sale, 12 to 26 November 2026 , with free delivery on orders of $200 or more. FINE PRINT: Logitech's Singapore website lists the keyboards but sends buyers to Lazada and Shopee instead of selling direct, so compare those prices too. BEST FOR: a first mechanical keyboard, students, and anyone who wants the Logitech G Hub software for macros. 
 Harvey Norman Black Friday Comes Early: G413 TKL SE $79 (was $94), G512 $99 (was $139), PRO X TKL Lightspeed $189 (was $279). 12-26 Nov 2026.
 Valid till 26 Nov 2026
 Get Deal 3 Razer: Best for Gaming, BlackWidow V4 75% at $219 and Cyber Weekend to 30 November
 The gaming brand with the widest range on Singapore shelves right now. PRICE: on razer.com/sg-en on 21 November 2026 the BlackWidow V4 X starts at $209.90 . At Harvey Norman the hot-swappable BlackWidow V4 75% is $219 (was $290) , the Huntsman V3 Pro Tenkeyless (analog optical, adjustable actuation) is $279 (was $349) and the Huntsman V3 Pro Mini is $199 (was $279) until 26 November. THE DEAL: Razer's own Cyber Weekend runs 16 to 30 November 2026 : members get early access to 22 November, then the sale opens to everyone from 23 to 30 November. Orders get free shipping , and until 22 November a free gift with S$129 spend (two gifts at S$259) plus bonus Razer Silver. FINE PRINT: the gift and early-access terms say they are for Razer members (a free RazerID) and cannot be combined with other offers. BEST FOR: gamers who want Synapse software and Chroma lighting that matches a Razer mouse and headset. 
 Razer Cyber Weekend 16-30 Nov 2026: free shipping, free gift with S$129 spend to 22 Nov (members). BlackWidow V4 75% $219 at Harvey Norman to 26 Nov.
 Valid till 30 Nov 2026
 Get Deal 4 ASUS ROG: Best Premium Wireless Keyboard, Azoth NX at $389 to 26 November
 The splurge pick for people who want a premium wireless board from a big brand with local service. PRICE (Harvey Norman, 21 November 2026): the ROG Azoth NX (75%, gasket mount, OLED display, tri-mode wireless) is $389, down from $429 ; the black versions showed out of stock online that day, the white ones did not. The ROG Strix Scope II 96 Wireless is $249 (was $279) , the Falchion Ace HFX magnetic 65% is $289 (was $319) and the budget TUF Gaming K3 Gen II is $109 (was $129) . THE DEAL: Harvey Norman's Black Friday Comes Early sale, 12 to 26 November 2026 . BEST FOR: anyone who wants a solid, quiet, gasket-mounted board without building a custom keyboard, and ASUS users who already run Armoury Crate. 
 Harvey Norman Black Friday Comes Early: ROG Azoth NX $389 (was $429), Strix Scope II 96 Wireless $249 (was $279), TUF K3 Gen II $109. 12-26 Nov 2026.
 Valid till 26 Nov 2026
 Get Deal 5 Corsair: Best Full-Size Keyboard Under $160, K70 Core RGB at $154
 The pick if you want a full-size board with a number pad and a volume dial for little money. PRICE (online.challenger.sg, 21 November 2026): the K70 Core RGB (full-size, linear red switches, media dial) is $154 (list $159) , the K65 Plus Wireless 75% is $232 (list $240) , the Vanguard 96 is $260 and the hall effect K70 Pro TKL is $266 . WHERE TO BUY: Corsair's own website has no Singapore store, so Challenger is the easiest place to buy one locally with a Singapore warranty. NO DATED SALE: Challenger's Festive Grand Deals codes (16 to 30 November) cover selected PCs and notebooks, not keyboards. BEST FOR: spreadsheet users and gamers who want the numpad, plus anyone already using Corsair's iCUE software. 
 Visit website 6 Lemokey: Best Hall Effect Keyboard for Gaming, P1 HE at $250
 Keychron's gaming label, sold through the same Singapore store, and the one to look at if you want magnetic switches in a metal case. PRICE (keychronsg.com, 21 November 2026): the P1 HE (75%, wireless, aluminium, Gateron magnetic switches, knob) is $250 , the wired 8K-polling L5 HE is $299 , and the regular mechanical P1 Pro is $195 (only the brown-switch version was in stock). WHY HALL EFFECT: you can set how deep each key must travel before it fires, and rapid trigger resets a key the moment you lift it, which helps in fast shooters. NO SALE: no dated promotion was shown on the store. BEST FOR: competitive players who want Keychron-level build quality instead of an all-plastic gaming board.

 How we picked and checked 
 We picked one brand for each kind of buyer: an all-rounder for Mac and Windows, the cheapest good keyboard, gaming, premium wireless, full-size on a budget and hall effect gaming. On 21 November 2026 we read prices from the brand's own Singapore store where it sells direct (keychronsg.com, razer.com/sg-en), and from Harvey Norman and Challenger for brands that do not sell direct here (Logitech's Singapore site links out to Lazada and Shopee; Corsair has no Singapore store). Sale dates come from the published terms: Harvey Norman's Black Friday Comes Early (12 to 26 November) and Razer's Cyber Weekend (16 to 30 November). We left out SteelSeries, Wooting and Akko because we could not confirm a current Singapore price or Singapore shipping on an official channel. 
 How to choose a mechanical keyboard 
 Size first. Full-size keeps the number pad; tenkeyless (TKL) drops it for more mouse room; 75% keeps the arrow keys and function row in an even smaller footprint. Most people are happiest with TKL or 75%. 
 Pick a switch feel. Linear (red) switches are smooth and quiet-ish, tactile (brown) give a bump you can feel, clicky (blue) are loud. If you share an office or a bedroom, skip clicky. 
 Hot-swappable means upgradeable. Keychron, Lemokey and the BlackWidow V4 75% let you pull switches out without soldering, so you can change the feel later. 
 Wireless for a clean desk. Tri-mode boards (Bluetooth, 2.4GHz dongle, cable) like the Keychron K8 Max and ROG Azoth NX switch between a laptop and a desktop at the touch of a key. 
 Mac users: Keychron ships Mac keycaps in the box; most gaming brands are Windows-first. 
 Watch the end dates. Harvey Norman's prices end on 26 November and Razer's Cyber Weekend on 30 November.

 Frequently Asked Questions
 What is the best mechanical keyboard to buy in Singapore? + For most people, the Keychron K8 Max: a wireless tenkeyless board with hot-swappable switches, Mac and Windows keycaps and an aluminium frame, $181 on keychronsg.com on 21 November 2026. If you mainly game, the Razer BlackWidow V4 75% is $219 (was $290) at Harvey Norman until 26 November.
 What is the cheapest decent mechanical keyboard in Singapore? + The Logitech G413 TKL SE at $79 (was $94) at Harvey Norman, in its Black Friday Comes Early sale from 12 to 26 November 2026. The Logitech G512 is $99 (was $139) in the same sale, and the ASUS TUF Gaming K3 Gen II is $109 (was $129).
 Is a hall effect (magnetic) keyboard worth it? + For fast competitive games, yes. Magnetic switches let you set how far a key travels before it registers and support rapid trigger, which resets a key the moment you lift it. In Singapore they start around $179 (Razer Huntsman V3 HE Mini at Harvey Norman) and $199 (Keychron K2 HE). For typing and office work, a regular mechanical switch is cheaper and just as good.
 When do the Black Friday keyboard deals end in Singapore? + Harvey Norman's Black Friday Comes Early prices (Logitech, Razer and ASUS keyboards) run from 12 to 26 November 2026. Razer's Cyber Weekend on razer.com/sg-en runs from 16 to 30 November, with members' early access and the gift-with-purchase to 22 November and public access from 23 to 30 November.
